Took a hike up a creek today. This is an old creek that was used by lumberjacks to float logs down to the river. Pulled a beautiful little brook trout out for dinner later this week too.

Last day of summer break for my kid and last day of natural brook trout season, so we hit up a really good creek and took a hike. Really bendy, it runs for hundreds of miles, lots of log jams and deep pools, nice weedbeds, and rocks and it's full of beautiful brook trout that I can get back to in the spring. It's really hard to fish this late in the year because the waters low and the brush is thick. it's a goldmine in the springtime.

Stocked ponds and lakes are open year round, it's just the naturals are going to spawn soon so it's shutdown until after new years.
